fundamental.summary: TXN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, no government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 70 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (396.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event 70 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (10/10) with contrarian congressional buying and bullish MACD/Supertrend create a classic capitulation setup near support (149.17), offering asymmetric risk/reward for patient swing traders.
